BOTTLE.description: Dangerous seasonal brew made by Grandma (TM), held within a reused glass bottle. Don't question why the contents are glowing, instead ask how in the world you keep breaking the bottle, and how you keep getting new ones.
BOTTLE.name: BOTTLE

TASER.description:
Uniquely designed stun gun that delivers shocks by mashing the button! Especially effective against lawyers.
Model by Poodros.
TASER.name: TASER

ARM CANNON.description:
Darn, looks like you forgot the long beam upgrade...
An advanceed weapon from an unknown time said to be used by the greatest space hunter in the galaxy...
Model by Vic.
ARM CANNON.name: ARM CANNON

MAGLITE CLUB.description:
A sturdy flashlight made to withstand a hardy beating, and dish beatings back out too. Great for when you can't see what's right in front of you. Average overall.
Halloween 2020 Melee made by Vic.
MAGLITE CLUB.name: MAGLITE CLUB

CRICKET BAT.description: A regulation-size cricket bat, used for the sport of cricket. It's well worn, so it won't crack on you, even while you're cracking the skulls of your enemies. Functionally identical to the Crowbar.
CRICKET BAT.name: CRICKET BAT

CANDY CANE.description: Absurdly sized holiday treat in StyLiS flavor! Use it to bring cheer to the scrooges in the warzone. Short range but very fast to swing!
CANDY CANE.name: CANDY CANE

BARE FISTS.description:
Who needs weapons when YOU are the weapon?
Lay the smack down on your foes with a flurry of punches. You'll also run pretty fast on your feet too!
Don't expect to be too effective in combat...
Cannot unlock skins for this weapon.
BARE FISTS.name: BARE FISTS

FLAME OF OLYMPIA.description:
A torch whose fire never seems to stop burning with the emotions of competition and sportsmanship shown throughout the events it will kick off. It is truly a monumental event for you to even be holding this.
Model by Shelby.
FLAME OF OLYMPIA.name: FLAME OF OLYMPIA

NIGHTSTICK.description:
A traditional club carried by police officers and private security forces alike. Fast swing speed with middling damage.
Welcome to my DEATH MACHINE, interloper!
Model by Shay.
NIGHTSTICK.name: NIGHTSTICK

PACIFIC FM.description:
Tune: Cold Front
A skywave radio customized to pick up a secure frequency on the air waves. Produced in a far off east factory...
Model by Victor.
PACIFIC FM.name: PACIFIC FM

SCL-S2: ID.description:
Melee for the winners of the second season of the StyLiS Competitive League.
Using the power of fire, launch a magic fireball towards your foes!
Congratulations to Icarus Dash!
SCL-S2: ID.name: SCL-S2: ID

STICK GRENADE.description: A deactivated explosive. Still useful for clobbering your enemies over the head. Quick swing time with lower damage.
STICK GRENADE.name: STICK GRENADE

KEYBOARD.description: You know that one guy? The guy that always seems to land a headshot every shot. The one who taunts after every kill. The keyboard warrior in you needs this instrument to enact your revenge.
KEYBOARD.name: KEYBOARD

TOY GUN.description: A toy noisemaker/dart-shooter revolver made to entertain children. Generally rounded out stats overall.
TOY GUN.name: TOY GUN

UCHIWA.description:
A war fan of ancient design. Great for bonkin' the heads of your enemies! Soldiers who use this often feel the need to scream Tenno Heika.
Model by Shelby.
UCHIWA.name: UCHIWA

THE COUNTDOWN.description: Thank you for supporting Phantom Forces and StyLiS Studios up to the year 2023!
THE COUNTDOWN.name: THE COUNTDOWN

MJOLNIR.description: You, soldier of fortune, happened upon a power beyond your mortal understanding. You take the weapon, hold it the boundless skies and know that you are worthy.
MJOLNIR.name: MJOLNIR

ASP BATON.description: A collapsible baton intended for police use. Quick swing and movement speed with poor range.
ASP BATON.name: ASP BATON

STARLIS FUNPOST.description: A wand of magical origin, imbued with the ancient magic of times gone by. It is powered by DEAD MEMES!
STARLIS FUNPOST.name: STARLIS FUNPOST

TRENCH MACE.description: A relic from the trenches of World War I. Quick swing speed with higher than average damage.
TRENCH MACE.name: TRENCH MACE

CLONKER.description:
A giant wooden sword toy being repurposed into the ultimate holiday bonker! Good speed, good reach, average damage.
Holiday 2020 melee made by Makosushi.
CLONKER.name: CLONKER

BRASS KNUCKLE.description: A small weapon intended to be held in a clenched fist to improve punching force. Very short range with incredibly fast swing speeds.
BRASS KNUCKLE.name: BRASS KNUCKLE

BLOXY.description: A staff commemorating the milestones Phantom Forces has achieved, Thank you for being a part of it's history.
BLOXY.name: BLOXY

FUMELEE.description: S-stylis.. please dont turn me into marketable plushies.. STYLIS!!
FUMELEE.name: FUMELEE

CROWBAR.description:
A long pry bar, useful for getting into crates that are nailed down. It's also good for dealing with dangerous aliens. Quick swing time with moderate damage.
Model by Shay.
CROWBAR.name: CROWBAR

FIXER.description:
A simple tool for a simple job, ain't gonna complicate things.
Model by Darkman_Bree.
FIXER.name: FIXER

SPARKLER.description: Fourth of July; The town really outdid itself this year. I feel like I'm watching every dollar I paid in property tax explode in my face.
SPARKLER.name: SPARKLER

SLEIGH BELLS.description: JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE!
SLEIGH BELLS.name: SLEIGH BELLS

SLAY BELLS.description: Jingle the jangle of any one who opposes you. Very short range with incredibly fast swing speeds.
SLAY BELLS.name: SLAY BELLS

TANZANITE PICK.description: A truly retro pickaxe crafted from jewels. Great for finding rare ores in the wild. Halloween 2020 Melee.
TANZANITE PICK.name: TANZANITE PICK

BRICK.description:
The perfect tool for liberation, torn directly from a wall of stone.

Model submitted by Vic
BRICK.name: BRICK

GOLDEN PAN.description: Like the Frying Pan, but way cooler. 😎
GOLDEN PAN.name: GOLDEN PAN

FRYING PAN.description:
This steel frying pan is great for cooking with. Few things are scarier than a demolition man holding one of these things charging at you. Higher damage with a slower swing.
PWONG!
FRYING PAN.name: FRYING PAN
